title: 第10章 牵引洞天第11章 神秘宝塔
slug: 时空洞天三千法则铸无上
content_zh:
凌宇怀着忐忑不安的心情走进“归墟”大殿，虽然之前已经做好了充分的准备，但正式面对的时候心情还是难以平静，患得患失起来。
进入大殿后，空荡荡的大殿只有中央有一座天然形成的传送法阵，散发着神秘的光芒，深邃而幽静。
这就是秘境进出归墟之地的门户，是天然形成的自然阵法，只要是具有一定规模的秘境都有，只能在心底赞叹一句。
“造物主大气！”
凌宇深吸一口气，直接进入传送法阵，传送法阵能量充足，凌宇只是激活法阵，只觉一阵天旋地转，又换了天地。
归墟之地，作为万物最后的归宿，是一个神秘而可怕的地方。
它不仅是生灵死后残留洞天的埋葬之地，更是一个充满神秘与未知的虚空之地。
有人说归墟之地连通地府，是人间界进入地府的另外一个入口，但是却从来没有生灵能够找到这条路。
归墟之地在无尽的虚空之中，与世隔绝。这里没有星辰光辉，更没有日月的交替，只有无尽的黑暗和永恒的寂静。
凌宇望着阵法外面空间被不断的扭曲和重塑，只觉得头皮发麻。
这里的规则与外界截然不同，空间的形态变幻莫测，时而拉伸，时而压缩，给人一种错乱和失重的感觉。
空间风暴毫无规律的肆虐而出，虚空裂缝随处可见。
各种幻影和幻象频繁出现，如果心智不坚，没有阵法保护，修行者往往会走出法阵，迷失其中，成为归墟之地的一部分。
凌宇努力平复心境，将双手贴在阵法阵眼之上，看着围绕着阵法的一层薄薄光膜，很难想象这层薄薄的光膜竟然可以阻挡住归墟之地的侵蚀。
向阵眼输入法力与意念，经过阵法的加持，凌宇的意念穿透阵法薄膜，进入归墟之地，游荡在死寂的空间之中。
凌宇感觉自己化为了一尊无所不能的神灵，俯瞰整个归墟之地，当然这只是幻觉，是法力突然暴涨后带来的后遗症。
但归墟之地的许多艰难困阻在这个时候都不再是秘密，在自己的意念感知之中如掌上之纹，清晰可见。
什么时候出现空间折叠，什么时候出现空间风暴自己此时都感知得一清二楚。
凌宇放开神念感知着这一切，搜寻着能与自己灵魂共鸣的洞天。
不一会儿，凌宇就感受到一股莫名的吸引力，呼唤着自己前往，凌宇瞬间将意念投往呼唤之地。

只见一个快要崩塌的洞天处于虚空裂缝中，不断地传出亲近之意。
凌宇赶忙投出意念查看，只见洞天中漆黑一片，空荡荡的，连火行法则都没凝聚，再仔细一感受都不能自主汲取虚空能量。
就这还“勾引”自己，凌宇果断撤走意念，不知是那个倒霉的五境之下“穷鬼”修士刚刚被人嘎掉了，洞天落入此地裂缝，连一点利用价值都没有。
摒弃杂念，凌宇放开心神不断的在归墟之地“扫荡”，时不时的会出现一些残破不堪，不能自主汲取虚空能量的无主洞天。
凌宇一次次的乘兴而来，败兴而归，都快麻木了。
content_en:
Ling Yu walked into the "Guixu" hall with an uneasy mood. Although he had been fully prepared before, he still couldn't calm down when he formally faced it, and he started to worry about gains and losses.
After entering the main hall, the empty main hall only has a naturally formed teleportation circle in the center, which exudes a mysterious light, is deep and quiet.
This is the gateway to and from the secret realm. It is a naturally formed natural formation. As long as there is a secret realm of a certain scale, I can only admire it from the bottom of my heart.
“Creator Atmosphere!”
Ling Yu took a deep breath and entered the teleportation array directly. The teleportation array had sufficient energy. Ling Yu just activated the array and felt that the world was spinning and the world had changed.
The place of Guixu, as the final destination of all things, is a mysterious and terrifying place.
It is not only a burial place where the cave remains after death, but also a void place full of mystery and unknown.
Some people say that the Land of Guixu is connected to the underworld and is another entrance from the human world to the underworld, but no living being has ever been able to find this way.
The place of Guixu is in the endless void, isolated from the world. There are no stars here, no alternation of the sun and the moon, only endless darkness and eternal silence.
Ling Yu felt his scalp numb as he looked at the space outside the formation being constantly distorted and reshaped.
The rules here are completely different from those in the outside world. The shape of the space is unpredictable, sometimes stretching and sometimes compressing, giving people a feeling of chaos and weightlessness.
Space storms raged out irregularly, and cracks in the void could be seen everywhere.
Various phantoms and illusions appear frequently. If the mind is not strong and there is no protection from the formation, the practitioner will often walk out of the formation, get lost in it, and become part of the place of return to ruins.
Ling Yu tried to calm down and placed his hands on the formation's eyes. Looking at the thin film of light surrounding the formation, it was hard to imagine that this thin film of light could actually block the erosion of the Guixu Land.
Inputting mana and thoughts into the formation eye, with the blessing of the formation, Ling Yu's thoughts penetrated the film of the formation, entered the Land of Return to Ruins, and wandered in the dead space.
Ling Yu felt like he had transformed into an omnipotent god, overlooking the entire Guixu Land. Of course, this was just an illusion, a sequelae caused by the sudden surge in mana.
But the many difficulties and obstacles in Guixu Land are no longer secrets at this time, they are clearly visible in the perception of his mind like the lines on his palm.
I can clearly sense when space folds and space storms occur.
Ling Yu let go of his spiritual thoughts to perceive all this, searching for the cave that resonated with his soul.
After a while, Ling Yu felt an inexplicable attraction, calling him to go, and Ling Yu instantly directed his thoughts to the calling place.
I saw a cave that was about to collapse in the cracks in the void, and messages of closeness were constantly coming out.
Ling Yu hurriedly cast his mind to check, and saw that the cave sky was pitch black and empty. Even the laws of fire were not condensed. No matter how carefully he felt, he could not draw the energy of the void independently.
Just to "seduce" himself, Ling Yu decisively withdrew his thoughts. Unexpectedly, the unlucky "poor ghost" monk under the Five Realms had just been killed. The cave fell into the cracks here, and there was no use value at all.
Abandoning distracting thoughts, Ling Yu relaxed his mind and continued to "sweep" the place of ruins. From time to time, there would be some dilapidated and unowned caves that could not independently absorb void energy.
Ling Yu came here again and again to take advantage of the excitement, and then returned disappointed. He was almost numb.
